shadows.name: glass-elevation
shadows.purpose: Ambient depth for all glass cards.

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Base translucent container for widgets and header controls.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(40, 40, 40, 0.38); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; color: #ebdbb2; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.2); }

components.name: Search Box
components.description: Full-width keyboard search input with instant focus recognition.
components.css: .ds-search-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: rgba(40, 40, 40, 0.38); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-search-box:focus-within { border-color: rgba(250, 189, 47, 0.45); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(250, 189, 47, 0.2); } .ds-search-box input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fbf1c7; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-badge { font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #bdae93; background: rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.15); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8px operational status indicator dot with crisp 1px perimeter border.
components.css: .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-dot.ds-up { background: #b8bb26; border: 1px solid rgba(184, 187, 38, 0.4); } .ds-dot.ds-down { background: #fb4934; border: 1px solid rgba(251, 73, 52, 0.4); }

components.name: Release Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(211, 134, 155, 0.18); color: #d3869b; border: 1px solid rgba(211, 134, 155, 0.35); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview: An ambient browser entry surface engineered specifically for keyboard-first developers in tiling window managers (Hyprland / Arch Linux). The canvas is intentionally transparent to expose the compositor wallpaper blur, while frosted Gruvbox glass cards float with tactile presence without visual clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Latency Ambient Surface: Designed for instant new-tab paints with local-first cached telemetry.
Gruvbox Dark Glassmorphism: Deep warm slate translucent cards (rgba(40, 40, 40, 0.38)) bound with hairline borders.
Tabular Monospace Precision: Clock ticks, release tags, and shortcuts use aligned monospace figures to eliminate layout jitter.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: Status dots and glowing accents use crisp 1px perimeter rings rather than diffuse colored drop-shadow halos.

rules.name: The Warm Hover Rule
rules.body: Interactive hover highlights use warm foreground overlays (rgba(235, 219, 178, 0.06)) rather than cold white washes.

rules.name: The Tabular Stability Rule
rules.body: All numeric data, release tags, and clocks declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to guarantee spatial stillness across updates.

dos: Do declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all dynamic values and timestamps.
Do preserve the transparent body canvas to expose compositor window blur in Hyprland.
Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio across all text and icon pairs.
Do provide fallback stale data from localStorage whenever external APIs error or throttle.
donts: Don't add colored zero-offset drop-shadow halos around cards or status dots.
Don't use cold white (rgba(255, 255, 255, ...)) for hover states; tint overlays with Gruvbox warm foreground (rgba(235, 219, 178, ...)).
Don't introduce blocking layout shifts or multi-second entrance animations on tab opening.
